title: Corn, twenty-six
logline: September 12. The corn, from above this time, and beside the tray, the pup's nose at the table's edge. The first anniversary page with any animal in it.

panels.composition: The corn tray from directly above on the bare table, and at the table's edge, entering the page, a small dog's nose and one ear, pointed at the corn. Nothing else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a paper tray of buttered corn on a bare table seen from directly above with a small dog's nose and one ear entering at the table's edge pointed at it, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Twenty-six. A nose at the edge.
